card.name: Partway through drug names in interactions
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name (such as hypoglycemia, diltiazem, emtricitabine, clomipramine, cidofovir) or a linking word like 'to' or 'affects' in drug-interaction text, where another drug is about to be named.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Split-off middle pieces of drug or medical terms in interaction passages.

modes.label: Linking verbs in interactions
modes.description: Small verbs or 'to' that link one drug to the effect on another drug.
